summary: Frontend-only retest on web preview (390x844). Full editor->history round trip verified: created quote via editor-save-button -> 'Saved to your history.' toast appeared; history-card-<realId> rendered with the real backend id (no 'undefined'); tapping the card reopened the editor with ocrText populated to the original quote; history-delete-<id> removed the card and showed 'Quote removed.' toast. No 'pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning was captured during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: history.tsx wraps the card preview with <View style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>, which correctly avoids the deprecation warning via style prop.
editor.tsx save path invalidates ['quotes'] query and sets draft.id from saved.id, so the subsequent history fetch returns a card with a real id.
seed_data_creation: One test quote created and then deleted during the run (TEST Book Title / TEST Author / 'The only way out is through.'); no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Editor->History flow is fully working on web preview. Backend serialization (id vs _id) was fixed in iteration 1 and confirmed working here via the live UI. If re-running, use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (https://quote-canvas-15.preview.emergentagent.com) and viewport 390x844.
rca_of_issue: n/a - previously reported bugs (undefined history-card id and pointerEvents deprecation warning) are both resolved.
